title: Known-object test, TOI-7610.01
summary: Former exoplanet lead retired 2026-09-27. Gaia DR3 source 3071787586789910144 has an SB1 orbit (P 90.4224 d, K1 12.14 km/s, 23 accepted RVs), giving a binary mass function 0.0144 solar masses and a conditional minimum companion mass about 0.238 solar masses. Independent cached-TPF analysis reproduces the failed S99 localization at 2.92 arcsec/5.71 bootstrap sigma. The photometric anomaly is preserved, but no target-planet candidate survives.
